repos.summary_zh: dockur/windows 仓库提供 Docker 镜像，在容器内运行完整 Windows 操作系统。集成 ISO 自动下载、KVM 硬件加速和 Web 远程查看器，支持 Win11/10/服务器等多版本。通过 Docker Compose、CLI 或 Kubernetes 快速部署，适用于开发测试、遗留软件兼容、云原生 Windows 应用托管等场景。亮点包括全自动安装流程、硬件加速及多平台集成，极大简化 Windows 虚拟化部署。
repos.summary_en: The dockur/windows repository delivers a Docker image for running full Windows operating systems inside containers. It features automatic ISO downloading, KVM hardware acceleration, and a web-based viewer. Supporting Windows 11, 10, servers, and older versions, it enables quick deployment via Docker Compose, CLI, or Kubernetes. Ideal for development/testing, legacy software support, and containerized Windows apps in cloud or Linux environments. Highlights include fully automated setup, performance acceleration, and broad DevOps integration.

repos.description: Run macOS VM in a Docker! Run near native OSX-KVM in Docker! X11 Forwarding! CI/CD for OS X Security Research! Docker mac Containers.
repos.summary_zh: Docker-OSX通过KVM和OpenCore技术实现在Docker容器中运行接近原生性能的macOS虚拟机。支持X11图形转发和iPhone USB设备穿透，专为macOS安全研究（如iMessage漏洞分析）和自动化CI/CD流程设计，提供便携且隔离的测试环境，显著提升安全研究员的工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Docker-OSX leverages KVM and OpenCore to run near-native macOS virtual machines inside Docker containers. It features X11 GUI forwarding and iPhone USB passthrough, specifically designed for macOS security research (including iMessage analysis) and CI/CD automation. This solution provides security researchers with a portable, isolated, and reproducible testing environment for efficient vulnerability discovery.

repos.description: Virtual machines for iOS and macOS
repos.summary_zh: UTM 是一款基于 QEMU 的 iOS 和 macOS 全系统虚拟化工具，支持 x86_64、ARM64、RISC-V 等 30 多种处理器架构。它提供 JIT 加速版本和无需越狱的 SE 解释器版本，可在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上运行 Windows、Linux 等操作系统。利用 Hypervisor 和 Virtualization 框架实现硬件加速，是移动设备和桌面端的强大虚拟化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: UTM is a full-featured system emulator and virtual machine host for iOS and macOS, built on QEMU. It supports 30+ processor architectures including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V, enabling users to run Windows, Linux, and other operating systems on iPhones, iPads, and Macs. The platform offers JIT-based acceleration for optimal performance and a special SE (Slow Edition) using threaded interpretation that requires no jailbreak. With native frontends leveraging latest Apple APIs and hardware acceleration via Hypervisor.framework and Virtualization.framework, UTM delivers a powerful cross-platform virtualization solution for both mobile and desktop environments.

repos.description: An evolving how-to guide for securing a Linux server.
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供全面的 Linux 服务器安全加固实践指南，涵盖 SSH 密钥与 2FA 认证、UFW 防火墙配置、Fail2Ban/CrowdSec 入侵防御、AIDE 文件完整性监控等核心模块。通过 Ansible Playbooks 实现自动化部署，结合纵深防御理念，为系统管理员和 DevOps 提供从基础加固到持续审计的一站式安全解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a comprehensive, continuously updated guide for Linux server security hardening with actionable implementations. It systematically covers SSH hardening with key-based authentication and two-factor authentication, network security via UFW firewall and PSAD intrusion detection, application-layer protection using Fail2Ban and CrowdSec, and continuous monitoring through AIDE file integrity checks, Lynis auditing, and OSSEC HIDS. The guide emphasizes defense-in-depth strategies and provides production-ready Ansible Playbooks for automated deployment, making it an essential resource for system administrators, DevOps engineers, and security professionals seeking to implement robust server security from fundamentals to advanced threat detection.

repos.description: A self hosted virtual browser that runs in docker and uses WebRTC.
repos.summary_zh: Neko 是一款基于 Docker 的自托管虚拟浏览器，通过 WebRTC 实现低延迟桌面流传输。它提供安全隔离的浏览器环境，支持多用户同时访问，适用于隐私保护、团队协作和社交娱乐（如在线观影派对）。项目解决了传统共享方式（如 Discord）的崩溃问题，为远程互动提供稳定解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser running in Docker, streaming desktop via WebRTC. It offers a secure, isolated browsing environment with multi-user access, ideal for privacy protection, team collaboration, and social entertainment (e.g., watch parties). Designed to overcome instability of traditional sharing tools like Discord, it provides a stable, low-latency solution for remote interaction.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过Docker容器化技术结合KVM硬件加速，在非Apple硬件上实现macOS虚拟化。提供Web管理界面，支持macOS 11-15版本自动部署与灵活资源配置（存储/CPU/内存）。适用于iOS/macOS应用开发测试、CI/CD流水线及跨平台开发环境，为开发者提供无需Apple硬件的macOS虚拟化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This project enables macOS virtualization on non-Apple hardware through Docker containerization with KVM hardware acceleration. It features web-based management, automated deployment of macOS versions 11-15 (Big Sur to Sequoia), and flexible configuration of storage, CPU, and RAM resources. Supporting Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and GitHub Codespaces deployment, it is ideal for iOS/macOS app development testing, CI/CD pipelines, and cross-platform development environments, providing developers with a convenient, production-ready macOS virtualization solution without Apple hardware requirements.

repos.summary_zh: Termix是一款开源自托管的Web服务器管理平台，为系统管理员提供一体化运维解决方案。核心功能包括：全功能SSH终端（支持分屏与标签页）、SSH隧道管理（自动重连与健康监测）、远程文件管理（支持代码/媒体编辑与Sudo权限）、Docker容器管控及服务器监控（CPU/内存/磁盘/防火墙）。采用React+Tailwind构建现代化响应式界面，支持RBAC权限体系、OIDC/2FA认证与SQLite数据库加密，是Termius的开源免费替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Termix is an open-source, self-hosted web platform for comprehensive server infrastructure management. It provides a full-featured SSH terminal with split-screen and tab support, automated SSH tunneling with health monitoring, and a remote file manager with sudo privileges. The platform integrates Docker container management, real-time server monitoring (CPU/memory/disk/network/firewall), and RBAC-based team collaboration. Built with React and Tailwind CSS, it features OIDC/2FA authentication, encrypted SQLite storage, and automatic SSL setup, serving as a free, all-in-one alternative to commercial solutions like Termius.

repos.description: 📻Free and open-sourced terminal/ssh/sftp/ftp/telnet/serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice client(Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, HarmonyOS, iOS)
repos.summary_zh: electerm 是一款开源的跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，集成 SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/串口/RDP/VNC 等多种协议。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux（含 ARM64），提供全局热键、透明窗口、背景图片等特性。内置 AI 助手（DeepSeek/OpenAI）与 MCP 协议支持，实现命令建议与工具集成。通过 Zmodem/Trzsz 实现文件传输，并可将配置同步至 GitHub/Gitee Gist，是开发者管理远程服务器的全能工具。
repos.summary_en: electerm is an open-source, cross-platform terminal and remote connection client that consolidates SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC, and Spice protocols into a single application. Built on Electron, it supports Windows, macOS, and Linux (including ARM64 architectures). Key features include global hotkeys for instant access, transparent windows, terminal background images, and integrated AI assistants (DeepSeek, OpenAI) via MCP protocol for command suggestions and script generation. It facilitates file transfers through Zmodem and Trzsz, supports SSH tunneling and proxy configurations, and allows synchronization of bookmarks and settings to GitHub/Gitee Gist, making it a versatile tool for developers and system administrators managing remote infrastructure.

repos.description: Fast, native Rust + GPUI workspace for local and SSH with MCP tools—no WebView, no telemetry, open source.
repos.summary_zh: OxideTerm 是一款基于 Tauri 2 和纯 Rust SSH 实现的一体化终端工作台，将本地 Shell、SSH、SFTP、远程 IDE 和 AI 代理集成于单一原生二进制文件中。其核心技术亮点包括智能重连、连接复用、MCP 协议与 RAG 知识库的 AI 集成，以及无 Electron、无 OpenSSL 的轻量化架构，为开发者和运维人员提供高效、稳定的跨平台远程开发体验。
repos.summary_en: OxideTerm is an all-in-one terminal workspace built with Tauri 2 and pure Rust SSH, integrating local shells, SSH, SFTP, remote IDE, and AI agent into a single native binary. Key technical highlights include smart reconnection, connection multiplexing, MCP protocol with RAG-based AI integration, and a lightweight architecture without Electron or OpenSSL, delivering efficient and stable cross-platform remote development experience for developers and operations teams.

repos.description: A golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized by a Grafana dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go实现的SSH tarpit（endlessh），通过故意延迟响应浪费暴力破解攻击者时间，并导出Prometheus指标，配合Grafana仪表板可视化攻击源地理位置与统计数据。适用于SSH安全防护与威胁情报场景，支持Docker部署、GeoIP查询、健康检查，轻量高效且可观测性强。
repos.summary_en: A Golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) that delays responses to waste brute-force attackers' time while exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized via a Grafana dashboard showing geolocations and attack statistics. Ideal for SSH defense and threat intelligence, with Docker support, GeoIP lookup, and health checks.

repos.description: High-performance native SSH client in Rust, GPU-rendered with GPUI: host manager, terminal, WinSCP-style SFTP and port forwarding. Rust 编写、GPU 渲染的原生 SSH 客户端。
repos.summary_zh: ShellRS 是一款 Rust 编写的高性能跨平台原生 SSH 客户端，基于 GPUI 实现 GPU 渲染界面。集成 Xshell 风格主机管理、WinSCP 风格 SFTP 文件传输及端口转发，支持多级跳板与代理连接，无 Electron 依赖，并提供 CLI 供 AI 智能体调用。
repos.summary_en: ShellRS is a high-performance, cross-platform native SSH client written in Rust, featuring GPU-accelerated rendering powered by the GPUI framework from the Zed editor. It unifies Xshell-style host management, tabbed terminals, WinSCP-style dual-pane SFTP file transfer, and SSH port forwarding into a single integrated window. The client supports multi-level jump hosts, HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy connections, and stores credentials securely in the system keychain. With no Electron or JVM dependencies, it delivers native performance. A built-in CLI tool also enables AI agents like Claude Code to execute commands and transfer files on saved hosts.

repos.description: crate: run Linux VMs on iPhone and iPad
repos.summary_zh: crate是一款在iPhone和iPad上运行完整Linux发行版的虚拟机应用，完全在设备本地运行，无需远程连接或云端依赖。它采用Rust从零编写的arm64翻译引擎，性能远超QEMU TCG，支持Ubuntu、Debian和Arch Linux ARM，通过virglrenderer、ANGLE和MoltenVK实现GPU加速桌面，并针对触摸、键盘和折叠屏优化，让手机变成真正的Linux电脑，支持Claude Code等开发工具。
repos.summary_en: crate is a virtual machine app that runs full Linux distributions on iPhone and iPad, entirely on-device with no remote connection or cloud dependency. Powered by a Rust-based arm64 translation engine that outperforms QEMU TCG, it supports Ubuntu, Debian, and Arch Linux ARM with GPU-accelerated desktops via virglrenderer, ANGLE, and MoltenVK, and is optimized for touch, keyboard, and foldable screens, turning your phone into a real Linux computer that can run developer tools like Claude Code.
